SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-11-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-03-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ALEN CHALICH IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT DENISSE OGATA IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $587.39 (WHICH INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT TO MAKE 2 PAYMENTS OF $293.69 FOR A TOTAL OF $587.39. FIRST PAYMENT TO BE MADE BY AUGUST 19, 2022, AND SECOND PAYMENT TO BE MADE BY SEPTEMBER 19, 2022. PAYMENTS TO BE SENT VIA ZELLE. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE OCTOBER 03, 2022, HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFFS EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
